common.translationNote: This English version is an informational translation. If there is any discrepancy, the Catalan or Spanish version prevails.
common.externalPolicies: When you access an external service, its own terms and privacy policy apply.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.intro: Information about the ownership, purpose and general conditions of use of Tens pla?.
notice.identityBody: Tens pla? is a personal project under the responsibility of Xavier Delgado Garcia. The public contact channel is contacte@tenspla.cat. The website is https://tenspla.cat.
notice.natureBody: Tens pla? is an independent initiative, free for its users. It has no advertising and does not sell tickets directly. It is partly funded through affiliate links: on some plan pages, the button to buy tickets on Fever is a link from the Impact affiliate network, and if you buy a ticket Tens pla? may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These buttons are labelled on the plan page itself. Tens pla? does not rank plans by commission: the order depends on dates, filters and how complete each plan's information is.
notice.ticketsBody: Ticket or information links deliberately lead to external providers. The purchase, availability and the corresponding contractual relationship take place outside Tens pla?.
notice.informationBody: The data comes from identified sources. Dates, times, prices, locations and availability may change at the source. Tens pla? tries to keep the information up to date, but cannot guarantee that an external source will not be modified later.
notice.rightsBody: Third-party sources, brands, names and content keep the rights and conditions of their owners. Tens pla? is not an official service of the Generalitat de Catalunya, Ticketmaster or other providers, without prejudice to the authorised use of the corresponding sources and APIs.
notice.useBody: The information is provided for guidance only. Before attending an activity or buying a ticket, check the current details with the original provider.
notice.appBody: The Tens pla? Android app, distributed on Google Play under the identifier cat.tenspla.app, opens the same website https://tenspla.cat in the phone's browser (usually Chrome). This legal notice, the privacy policy and the local storage information of the website apply to it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data may be processed when you use Tens pla?, its website or its Android app, or when you contact the project.
privacy.controllerBody: Xavier Delgado Garcia is the data controller. You can get in touch at contacte@tenspla.cat. The website is https://tenspla.cat.
privacy.logsBody: The infrastructure records the IP address, date and time, HTTP method, requested path without parameters, protocol, HTTP status code, bytes sent and User-Agent. It does not record query strings or Referer. Express does not keep its own visitor tracking system.
privacy.analyticsBody: To know which pages and features are used and to improve the service, Tens pla? uses Umami, an open-source analytics tool installed on a server contracted by Tens pla? (stats.tenspla.cat), without cookies and without storing anything on your device. For each page view it records the page address and title (including campaign parameters, such as utm_source; before sending it, Tens pla? removes the click identifiers some networks add, such as fbclid), the referring page, browser, operating system, device type, screen size, language and approximate location (country, region and city). It also records these events: viewing a list of plans (with the list name), viewing a plan, tapping a Fever ticket button, saving or removing a saved plan and sharing a plan (with the plan's identifier), and, if you came from Instagram or TikTok, the network and campaign. Your IP address and browser are used at the time of the visit to work out the approximate location and a session identifier that changes every month; the IP address is not stored. The data is analysed in aggregate and is not used to identify you, to profile you or for advertising. It is not passed on to third parties for their own purposes; only the hosting provider processes it, on our behalf. If your browser has "Do Not Track" turned on, Umami does not record your visit.
privacy.emailBody: If you write to contacte@tenspla.cat, your email address, your name if you provide it, the content of the message and any other data you include voluntarily may be processed.
privacy.languageBody: The browser keeps quefem.language with the value ca, es or en to remember the chosen language. It is not an identification, tracking or profiling system.
privacy.locationBody: When you explicitly select territorial filters, the browser may keep the chosen province, comarca and/or municipality to give context to the homepage. No level is inferred, no GPS or account is used, and this preference involves no tracking or disclosure to third parties.
privacy.dataNatureBody: You do not need to provide personal data to browse Tens pla?. Writing to contacte@tenspla.cat is voluntary, but requires the minimum data needed to be able to reply. Technical connection data is generated automatically when you use the service.
privacy.purposesBody: Logs are used for security, abuse detection, operation and technical diagnosis. Usage statistics are used to know, in aggregate, which pages, features and social media posts are used, and to count clicks on ticket buttons. Emails are used to answer enquiries and handle corrections, privacy, content removal and legal matters.
privacy.basisBody: Technical processing needed to protect and run the service is based on the legitimate interest in security and operation. Usage statistics are based on the legitimate interest in knowing how the service is used in order to improve it, with minimised data, no cookies, nothing stored on your device and no profiling; you can object at any time (see "Rights"). Preferences kept on your device (language, location, saved plans) are stored because you ask for them, to make what you ask for work. Communications you start are processed to handle your request, on the basis of the legitimate interest in answering it. Where necessary, certain processing may be based on compliance with legal obligations.
privacy.retentionLogs: Technical logs rotate daily and are kept for approximately 14 days.
privacy.retentionLanguage: The language preference is kept until you change it or delete the browser's local data.
privacy.retentionLocation: The location preference is kept until you change it, remove it from the homepage or the filters, or delete the browser's local data.
privacy.retentionAnalytics: Usage statistics are kept for a maximum of 24 months.
privacy.retentionFavorites: Saved plans are kept on your device until you remove them or delete your browser's local data.
privacy.retentionEmail: Emails are kept only for as long as necessary to handle the request and, where applicable, for the periods needed to prove how it was handled or to address possible legal liabilities.
privacy.hetznerBody: Hetzner Online GmbH hosts the frontend, backend, SQLite, usage statistics (Umami), web infrastructure and technical logs. The server is in Falkenstein, Germany, eu-central zone. A data processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is in place.
privacy.ovhBody: OVHcloud hosts the contacte@tenspla.cat mailbox service and is involved when you voluntarily send an email.
privacy.sharingBody: Tens pla? does not sell or transfer personal data to third parties. Data may only be processed by the providers needed to deliver the service, by external services voluntarily activated by the user or where there is a legal obligation.
privacy.affiliateBody: When you tap the Fever ticket button on a plan page, a link from the Impact affiliate network opens and takes you to Fever. From there, Impact and Fever may use cookies or similar technologies on their own domains to attribute the purchase to Tens pla?, under their own policies. Tens pla? does not send them any of your data; its own statistics only count that the button was tapped.
privacy.appBody: The Tens pla? Android app opens this same website in the phone's browser (usually Chrome). It declares no device permissions (location, contacts, camera, photos…), has no advertising or analytics code of its own and processes the same data as the website, described in this policy. Google processes data related to downloading from Google Play and using the browser under its own policies.
privacy.externalTitle: External services triggered by the user
privacy.osmBody: OpenStreetMap is only contacted after you click «Show map». The choice is not kept globally.
privacy.mapsBody: Google Maps is not embedded: it only opens through a voluntary external link.
privacy.ticketmasterBody: Ticketmaster is queried from the backend. The browser only contacts it if you voluntarily open a ticket or information link.
privacy.feverBody: Fever and the Impact affiliate network are only contacted if you choose to tap a Fever ticket button.
privacy.sourcesBody: Links to original sources also lead to external services.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or objection, and portability where applicable, by writing to contacte@tenspla.cat. In particular, you can object to usage statistics by writing to us or by turning on your browser's "Do Not Track" option. You can also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
privacy.aepdLink: Go to the official AEPD website
privacy.automationBody: Tens pla? does not carry out profiling or make automated decisions about visitors.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.intro: Information about the functional preferences that Tens pla? saves in the browser.
storage.cookiesBody: Tens pla? uses no first-party or advertising cookies, sessions or login. Usage statistics (Umami) work without cookies and without storing anything on your device; what they record is explained in the Privacy policy. External services you choose to open (for example, Fever) may use their own cookies.
storage.languageBody: Only localStorage is used, with the key quefem.language and the values ca, es or en, to remember the selected language.
storage.locationBody: localStorage may save, with the key quefem.location, only the province, comarca and/or municipality you have explicitly selected. It is used to show contextual plans on the homepage; it uses no GPS, identifiers or account.
storage.favoritesBody: If you save plans with the heart, localStorage keeps, under the key quefem.favorites, each plan's identifier, its title and the date you saved it (up to 200 plans). The list exists only on this device: it is not stored on Tens pla? servers or linked to any account. To show current dates and prices, the Saved plans page requests each plan from the Tens pla? API, just like opening a plan page. When you save, remove or share a plan, Tens pla?'s own statistics (Umami, without cookies) count the action with the plan's identifier and no data about you. You can remove them one by one with the heart or delete them from your browser's data settings.
storage.sharingBody: These preferences do not identify people, are not used for advertising, analytics, tracking or profiling and are not shared with third parties.
storage.deleteBody: You can change the language from the Tens pla? selector, remove the location from the homepage or the filters, or delete the preferences from the browser's data settings.
storage.mapBody: OpenStreetMap is not loaded when you open a plan page. The connection is only created after you click «Show map», and this decision is not saved for future pages.
storage.offlineBody: Your browser keeps a copy of the app's files (code, styles, icons and an offline notice page) so that Tens pla? loads faster and can tell you when you have no internet. No plans, searches or personal data are stored, and you can delete it from your browser's data settings.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Contact with Tens pla? is exclusively by email; there is no web form.
contact.channelBody: You can write to contacte@tenspla.cat for general enquiries, event corrections, content removal, privacy or legal matters.
contact.requestsBody: If possible, state the name of the event, the Tens pla? link and which information you consider incorrect or which content you ask to have removed.
contact.minimumBody: Do not send unnecessary personal documentation. If it is necessary to confirm that you are entitled to request a removal, reasonable additional information may be requested depending on the case.
contact.ticketmasterBody: Express requests related to Ticketmaster content are reviewed as a priority, with an operational target of under 24 hours.
